Revivalistics: From the Genesis of Israeli to Language Reclamation in Australia and Beyond is a book written by linguist Ghil'ad Zuckermann . It was published in 2020 by Oxford University Press . The book introduces revivalistics , a trans-disciplinary field of enquiry exploring "the dynamics and problematics inherent in spoken language reclamation, revitalization, and reinvigoration".
